newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia diesel imports to almost double by 2001.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia diesel imports to almost double by 2001.

text.p: Indonesian state oil company Pertamina said its diesel oil imports will rise to 153,000 barrels per day (bpd) in fiscal 2000/2001 (April-March) from 84,000 bpd in 1996/97.

"The volume of diesel oil imports is 84,000 bpd in fiscal 1996/97, and in the year 2000/2001 it is estimated the import will almost double to 153,000 bpd," Pertamina president director Faisal Abda'oe told a seminar on palm oil.
"Therefore Pertamina has selected crude palm oil (cpo) to be studied as a source for alternative energy. Pertamina will study the possibility of using palm oil as a fuel," Abda'oe said.
